channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Nearly a dozen firms pay up to $100,000 monthly for early access to Trump's Truth Social posts
item.description: The launch of Truth API has raised insider trading concerns among economists and legal experts.

item.title: Japan and U.S. spend billions to save the yen, but it's still losing ground
item.description: Economists note that the U.S.-Japan intervention, though significant, does not address the root causes of the yen's weakness.

item.title: Bob Iger and Josh Kushner buy LA Lakers for record $12.5 billion, up 21% in 14 months
item.description: The pair purchase the team from Mark Walter, who paid $10 billion just over a year ago, and someone Magic Johnson once predicted would own the franchise.

item.title: Nvidia finds new funding path for AI boom using retirement assets
item.description: A $500 billion initiative could channel insurance and pension funds into GPU-backed projects as tech firms increase reliance on debt.
